allocation_failures.detail: Dense full user x item score matrix materialized in float64 (the default dtype) triggered a 3.35GiB allocation failure mid-round.
allocation_failures.root_cause: float64 full-matrix default instead of memory-safe sparse candidate tables

premature_stops.detail: Fixed 3-round cap ended the loop with ~99% of the budget unused.
Loop ended after 3 rounds with ~75% of the budget unused.
